title: Poquatuck (Orient Point / Long Beach Bay)
summary: Poquatuck is an Orient Point and Long Beach Bay placename in Southold, interpreted as a clear or open tidal cove or creek.
map_geometry_source: Approximate modern Orient Point / Long Beach Bay point used as a general proxy for the Poquatuck placename; not an exact historic boundary, cove, or neck coordinate.
introduction_content: Poquatuck is connected with Orient Point in Southold, and the name may have belonged more specifically to Long Beach Bay.
history_content: Poquatuck belongs to the Orient Point and Long Beach Bay landscape at the eastern end of the North Fork. Variant and local-history details appear in the historic moments below.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as a clear or open tidal river, cove, or creek. Pequanet is treated as a probable variant connected with an Orient neck reference, while Paquatuck at Terrell River is a separate Moriches placename with a related etymology.

Why Place Names Matter

“The names we use for places around us reflect our culture, identity and history.”

— Geographical Names Board of Canada, Strategic Plan 2014-2020 (2014), Chair’s message, PDF page 1
whereintheworld_content: Approximate/general point near Orient Point and Long Beach Bay. This marker is not an exact early-record or town-boundary coordinate.
